title: The Magic Key
purpose: Explore testable meta-properties of JSON as a constraint-defined, reversible, self-describing but non-self-executing research object, including representation effects on AI systems and exact interface compression for JANUS proof states.
new_findings: JSON anatomy frozen in Russian with strict separation of base syntax from external semantic layers.
First arXiv sweep links formal JSON models, JSON Schema logic/witness generation and structured-output LLM behavior.
High-value external signal: schema key wording can act as an instruction channel for LLM structured generation.
High-value external signal: JSON response register can change model answer distributions.
Boundary retained: schema-valid or structurally-valid does not imply semantic truth or authority.
Magic Key is split into MK_ID for exact-state identity and MK_FUTURE for certified future-semantic equivalence.
Minimality is no longer required by the complexity theorem candidate; a polynomial-size certified sufficient interface is enough.
BCEG-MK integration now targets transition congruence, decision sufficiency, replay lifting and explicit semantic-collision attacks.
R0 exact arena found an explicit semantic collision for a lossy structural key, proving that structural similarity is insufficient for MK_FUTURE authority.
A fixed-order ROBDD future interface survived 4,644 reachable CNF states with 0 semantic collisions and 55,728 total ASSIGN/EXISTS transition-congruence checks.
R0 observed 13,195 nontrivial safe merge pairs of distinct canonical CNFs with identical future semantics; this is a finite quotient-space result, not a universal theorem.
A nonvoting development dry-run showed syntactic live-variable metadata is not derivable from Boolean future semantics after canonical simplification; MK_ID and MK_FUTURE must remain separate layers.
algorithmic_spine: TOPA/Spider discovery + SEARCH_GRAMMAR + REPRESENTATION_GRAMMAR + INTERFACE_GRAMMAR + MK_ID/MK_FUTURE separation + BCEG exact boundary composition + quotient update algebra
safety_boundary: JSON is data; activation is interpreted by an external allowlisted deterministic interpreter and fails closed. Exact replay remains authority. Finite equivalence testing is not theorem authority.
next_gate: MK_BCEG_R1_SCALE_ORDER_AND_SYMBOLIC_CONGRUENCE: attack ROBDD variable-order sensitivity and known hard families, measure representation growth, and attempt a symbolic proof obligation for K(T_a(S))=U_a(K(S)) without full-state reconstruction.
